title: Resiliency helper kit: illustrative assets & quickstart visuals for timeouts, retries, and rate-limit recovery
creator: Evelyn Chen
description:
Goal: Produce a compact, brand-aligned "Resiliency helper kit" for onboarding flows and quickstart docs that explains common transient failures (rate limits, timeouts, retries) with clear visuals, microcopy, and one-click fallback screens. Deliverables:
- 6 SVG illustration variants (overview + 3 detailed states + compact inline icon set) sized for docs and console UI (480x320, 320x180, icon 40px).
- Two microcopy tracks: terse (for console inline messages) and explanatory (for docs/quickstart).
- A short explainer diagram for retry/backoff behavior (visual timeline with exponential curve and suggested retry strategy).
- Screenshot templates and annotated overlays for Console error states (desktop + mobile) showing recommended CTA placement, retry affordances, and telemetry links.
- Figma file with components, tokenized colors, and localization-ready text layers (EN + DE + JA placeholders).
Design decisions / constraints:
- Keep primary illustrations two-tone to match Redwood brand while keeping PNG fallbacks for older doc pipelines.
- Prefer static illustrations in quickstart (reduces distraction); add a micro-animation spec for console where space allows (subtle pulse on retry button).
- Inline console copy must be <110 characters; docs copy can be up to ~300 chars with an optional "how it works" expand panel.
- Accessibility: WCAG AA color contrast, alt text for all images, and clear focus states for retry CTA.
Trade-offs discussed:
- Full motion would better show backoff behavior but increases asset complexity and localization effort. Chosen to provide a static timeline diagram plus an optional Lottie spec for later iteration.
- Using icons only reduces cognitive load inside the console but makes first-time developer UX less explanatory; we provide paired icon + short copy by default and an expandable explanation for power users.
Metrics for success:
- Rate of users clicking the "Retry" CTA from the quickstart: +10% vs baseline within two weeks of release.
- Decrease in support tickets labeled "rate limit confusion" by 20% in first month.

Implementation notes and conventions for engineers/docs authors:
- SVGs exported with layers named per token convention: illustr/shape, illustr/accent, illustr/bg.
- Provide 2x and 3x raster exports for embedded screenshots.
- Include copy variants in a single CSV for localization pipeline.
- Console screenshot overlays should reference console CSS tokens: --redwood-primary, --redwood-muted, --redwood-cta.
